verdict.rationale: ZCode is built around a terminal agent and multi-agent collaboration (zcode-gh-1, zcode-docs-1). Its Goal feature plans, executes and verifies multi-step work (zcode-docs-2), and tasks can be triggered remotely from WeChat, Feishu or Telegram (zcode-docs-3). Hands-on users report the assistant 'works pretty well' and praise the harness (zcode-comm-15, zcode-comm-16), though one user hit frequent 'Cannot connect to API: write EPIPE' failures and had to keep retrying (zcode-comm-8). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the delegation workflow beyond marketing claims, and consistent independent evidence of reliable task execution.
